newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 30.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:

* In what could lead to a massive shift in industry practice, Twentieth Century Fox and Seagram's Universal are the first two studios to grant ABC's request for 5- to 5-1/2-year license fee terms on two TV shows for next season.

* Kelly Preston, who is quietly developing a solid comedienne career in pics like "Jerry Maguire" and "Nothing to Lose," has inked to star opposite Eddie Murphy and Jeff Goldblum in "Holy Man" for Disney -based Caravan Pictures.

* The balanced budget agreement, which the House and Senate are expected to approve as early as Wednesday, seals a multibillion-dollar bonanza for broadcasters, who are being handed a huge chunk of digital spectrum for free.
* Glenn Close and Meryl Streep will costar in and coproduce "Mary Stuart," a film adaptation of Friedrich Schiller's dramatic play about the 16th Century monarch.

* "Hercules" is muscling its way onto the small screen. Walt Disney Television Animation has begun pre-production on an ambitious 65-episode order for a TV version of the theatrical feature, the first such Disney movie-to-TV series since 1994's "The Lion King" spawned "Timon & Pumbaa."
